names.celestisynth:solar_crystal_armor_bonus: When receiving damage, the armor burst out a circle of flame, dealing damage and burning surrounding targets. Each piece increases the damage of the burst and the duration of the fire.
names.celestisynth:lunar_stone_armor_bonus: When the wearer is hurt, the armor has a 1/5 chance to significantly reduce the damage received. Each piece increases the damage reduction value.
names.celestisynth:solaris/passive_desc_1: The player gains fire immunity while holding the item - normal attacks with this item sets the target on fire for a few seconds.
names.celestisynth:solaris/passive_desc_2: When holding the right-button with the Solaris, the player can summon up to 5 solar bombs that will circle around them. Hurting a target redirects a solar bomb to them.
names.celestisynth:solaris/desc_1: Perform a graceful spin, inflicting damage and burning nearby entities.
names.celestisynth:solaris/desc_2: Dash forward, striking and temporarily igniting entities in your path.
names.celestisynth:crescentia/passive_desc_1: The player gains a level of damage resistance while holding the item - normal attacks with this item slows down the target for a few seconds.
names.celestisynth:crescentia/desc_1: Unleash a dazzling barrage of strikes on nearby entities, accompanied by a mesmerizing firework display.
names.celestisynth:crescentia/desc_2: Unleash a set of dragon-like projectiles, dragging enemies along with it whilst continuously slashing them.
names.celestisynth:breezebreaker/passive_desc_: The player gains a huge jump boost and fall damage immunity while holding the item, but takes 2.3x damage from all the other damage sources.
Every 15 skill casts activate or deactivate this passive. While active, the player gains a speed boost and reduces skill cooldowns by half. The effect wears off after 8 seconds.
names.celestisynth:breezebreaker/desc_1: Unleashes a powerful wind slash that inflicts tremendous damage upon impact.
names.celestisynth:breezebreaker/condition_2: Activate: Hold Right-click for 0.5 or more seconds
names.celestisynth:breezebreaker/desc_2: Executes Galestorm twice consecutively, overwhelming foes with a relentless onslaught of wind slashes.
names.celestisynth:breezebreaker/desc_3: Summons a destructive tornado that slices through any entities unfortunate enough to cross its path.
names.celestisynth:breezebreaker/desc_4: Swiftly dashes forward, inflicting massive damage to the first entity it encounters along the way.
names.celestisynth:breezebreaker/desc_5: Creates a towering vertical wheel of wind around the player, obliterating nearby entities with its devastating force.
names.celestisynth:poltergeist/passive_desc_1: All skills of this weapon tags every affected entity with a Phantom Tag. Slain foes with the tag become monstrous Aberrants that draw in nearby entities for 5 seconds.
names.celestisynth:poltergeist/desc_1: Executes a smash to the ground, dealing massive burst damage on surrounding entities. After 10 consecutive strikes, the weapon enables it's "Aberrant Form", allowing the next strike to enlarge and mutate a sucking aberrant from the ground. Killing an entity during "Aberrant Form" or jumping midair while striking instantly resets the cooldown of this ability.
names.celestisynth:poltergeist/desc_2: Creates a protective barrier capable of shattering any incoming projectiles while forcefully propelling the player backwards.
names.celestisynth:aquaflora/passive_desc_1: Every skill cast gives 3 seconds of speed to the caster.
names.celestisynth:aquaflora/desc_1: Launches a series of attacks capable of penetrating a row of entities.
names.celestisynth:aquaflora/desc_2: Uses a head-butt against a group of entities, pushing them away and inflicting significant damage. Activating this ability initiates the Blooming State, altering the weapon's skill set.
names.celestisynth:aquaflora/desc_3: During the execution of this skill, the player becomes immune to damage while delivering up to 20 individual attacks on entities within range. Dual wielding the same weapon enables the player to perform up to 40+ attacks, albeit with decreased damage.
names.celestisynth:aquaflora/condition_4: Activate: Right-click while holding SHIFT during Blooming State
names.celestisynth:aquaflora/desc_4: The player executes a backward dash, leaving a floral effect that draws nearby entities toward it. This ability deactivates the Blooming State, resulting in a modification of the weapon's skill set.
names.celestisynth:rainfall_serenity/skill_1: Eons, and Eons Through the Sky
names.celestisynth:rainfall_serenity/desc_1: When the bow is released, it emits a laser that can pierce through every entity, marking each with a "Quasar Mark" for 5 seconds. This mark can trigger nearby entities to shoot lasers at the marked target.
names.celestisynth:rainfall_serenity/desc_2: When the laser strikes a target with a "Quasar Mark", a portal spawns above and lasers will rain down around the target.
names.celestisynth:rainfall_serenity/desc_3: Increases speed massively and activates "True Invisibility" for 5 seconds.
names.celestisynth:rainfall_serenity/condition: Activate: Drop item on solid platform
names.celestisynth:rainfall_serenity/desc_4: Dropping this item on to a solid platform transforms this weapon into a turret that shoots anything nearby.
names.celestisynth:frostbound/passive_desc_1: Inflicting harm upon a target using this weapon induces a frostbound condition, significantly diminishing their strength and reducing their speed.
names.celestisynth:frostbound/passive_desc_2: When holding the right-button with the Frostbound, the weapon consumes Frostbound Shards and shoots them out towards nearby random entities, freezing them for a few seconds.
names.celestisynth:frostbound/desc_1: Executes a rhythmic movement sequence that inflicts damage on nearby entities multiple times, afflicting them with a frostbound effect.
names.celestisynth:frostbound/desc_2: Calls forth a maximum of five sizable ice formations in front of the caster, causing damage to entities and bestowing upon them a frostbound effect.
names.celestisynth:keres/passive_desc_1: After consecutively attacking targets 5 times in a row, the holder activates a Hellbane state - which increases the Keres' lifesteal and repeatedly ejects homing shadow projectiles towards nearby enemies.
names.celestisynth:keres/passive_desc_2: While using the Keres to cast a skill, the holder sacrifices 1.5 health every few seconds, but every single skill regenerates the holder's health to some degree when it lands on a target.
names.celestisynth:keres/passive_desc_3: When a skill hit a target, it gives a Cursebane effect to the target for 5 seconds. The effect reduces the healing rate of the target significantly.
names.celestisynth:keres/desc_1: Sends waves of slashes that bypasses armor. The amount of slashes is proportional to the degree of "Weapon-Consumed Blood".
names.celestisynth:keres/desc_2: Jumps to a location and sends a shockwave to the surroundings. The jumping distance is proportional to the degree of "Weapon-Consumed Blood".
names.celestisynth:keres/condition_3: Hold Right-click for 10 or more seconds
names.celestisynth:keres/desc_3: Sends out a giant rend that erases blocks and deals massive damage to targets along the way. The slash ignores all armor.
names.celestisynth:keres/notice: Unable to consume blood for Keres. Regeneration is required.

names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/page_1: We arrived at the location He sent us to just before last dusk, a march of many days. One last time, we slept on the dirt; this morning we rose with purpose anew, beginning to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.
names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/page_2: Construction is near complete. As I write, supplies make their way into our hospice - freshly hewn wood from the area, a shipment of glass from fort greater. Discovery awaits.
names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/page_3: I had never thought it possible, this magic seems to be messing with my mind. I swear there used to be a cellar below the chapel, yet even my second in command says it were never so... Surely I cannot be the one going mad?
names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/page_4: Scouts have returned with fantastic news, that of a village, and not too far to return the supplies here with ease after laying siege. However, magical research in this area seems to be inconclusive. We may be abandoning soon.
names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/entry_1/: We reached the location to which He bade us journey, a laborious march spanning many days. As the sun surrendered to dusk, we rested our wearied bodies upon the earth for what I trust to be the final time. This morn,
we rose with purpose anew, and began to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.
names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/entry_2/: Our construction draws nigh its completion. As I pen these very words, the final shipment of supplies flow into our haven - enough timber, freshly hewn from the surrounding wilds, to finish the enclosure, and panes of glass
sent from Fort Greater. Soon shall the research commence, the likes of which may yet shake the pillars of the world.
names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/entry_3/: A strange unease takes root within my mind. This magic - though wondrous - doth twist the senses. I could have sworn there was a cellar beneath the chapel's floor, and yet now none recall it. Even my most trusted lieutenant
claims such a thing never was. Am I alone in this delusion? Has madness begun to gnaw at me?
names.irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log/entry_4/: Our scouts return with tidings of a village, not far from our encampment. This is good news, for supplies dwindle. We shall lay siege and easily procure what is needed, for the distance is not great.
However, the magical research in these lands proves troublesome - few are the answers we seek. It may soon come to pass that we abandon this place, move to the next site.

names.simplyswords:uniquesworditem/netherfused: ◆  Echo
Your weapon swings echo, dealing additional unmitigated damage after a short delay.
◆  Berserk
When you have an armour value less than 10, your weapon swings siphon health from the target.
◆  Radiance
When hitting a target afflicted with weakness, gain Immolation for a short duration.
◆  Onslaught
When hitting a target afflicted with slowness, gain Onslaught for a short duration. (Onslaught grants you pulsing haste, but inflicts you with weakness when it expires).
◆  Nullification
Summons a Battle Standard on hit that periodically cleanses debuffs from allied players, while stripping buffs from enemies within its vicinity.
◆  Verdant Trail
Leave a trail of flowers that regenerate allies and harm enemies.
◆  Necromantic Arsenal
Chance on hit to summon a skeletal minion that fights with a copy of your weapon.
◆  Wolf Pack
Chance on hit to summon a wolf minion that fights with a copy of your weapon.
◆  Goat Stampede
Chance on hit to summon a stampede of goats that charge forward, knocking back and damaging anything in their path.
◆  Wing Buffet
Chance on hit to summon dragon wings that send forward a gust of wind, damaging and knocking back enemies in front of you.
◆  Dragon's Maw
Nearby enemies have a chance to cause you to summon a dragon head head that spews forth a damaging fire breath.
◆  Precise
Chance to gain several stacks of Precision when activating a signature ability.
◆  Mighty
Chance to gain several stacks of Might when activating a signature ability.
◆  Stealthy
Chance to gain Stealth when activating a signature ability.
◆  Renewed
When activating a signature ability, you have a chance to significantly reduce its cooldown.
◆  Accelerant
Berserker's Berserking signature ability no longer grants you Berserking, but its cooldown is reduced significantly.
◆  Leaping
When landing a Leap Slam you have a chance to immediately leap again.
◆  Spellshield
Chance on spell cast to gain Barrier.
◆  Spellforged
While in your mainhand, this weapon grants you increased spell power.
◆  Soulshock
While held, this weapon grants you increased Soul & Lightning spell power.
◆  Spell Standard
Chance on spell hit to drop a Spell Standard that grants Precision & Spellforged.
◆  War Standard
When using a forward charge ability, drop a War Standard that grants Might and reveals nearby enemies.
◆  Deception
When you evade an attack using Evasion Mastery, you have a chance to cleanse Revealed.
